blocks.title: Indicator
blocks.text: Indicator woh madda hai jo titration ka end point nishan-zada karne ke liye rang badalta hai. Acid-base indicators acid mein ek rang aur base mein doosra dikhate hain.

Acid-base titration mein istemal hone wale zyada tar indicators kamzor organic acids ya kamzor organic bases hain. Solution mein kamzor-acid indicator HIn ko HIn se H+ + In- likha ja sakta hai, jahan In- indicator ka anion hissa hai. Reaction reversible hai, to HIn aur In- dono maujood hain, aur dikhne wale rang is wajah se hain ke HIn aur In- ke rang mukhtalif hain. Tezabi solutions mein maujood In- ions Bronsted bases ki tarah acid se protons qubool karte hain, to indicator zyada tar ghair-ionised shakal HIn mein hota hai. Basic solutions mein base ke OH- ions indicator ke paida kiye hue H+ ions se milte hain, indicator ke molecules H+ ki kami poori karne ke liye mazeed ionise hote hain, aur indicator zyada tar apne anion In- ki shakal mein hota hai; solution tab base wala rang dikhata hai, jo litmus ke liye neela hai.

Mukhtalif indicators mukhtalif pH qeematon par rang badalte hain; rang kisi pH par HIn aur In- ki nisbati miqdaron par munhasir hai. Misal ke taur par methyl red pH 4.4 aur 6.2 ke darmiyan surkh se peela hota hai: pH 4.4 par indicator zyada tar HIn molecules ki shakal mein hai, jo surkh dikhte hain. Figure 9.2 kuch aam indicators ki ranges deti hai.

blocks.prompt: Wazahat karein ke indicator tezabi aur basic solution mein apna rang kaise badalta hai (Quick Check 9.6b).
blocks.explanation: Indicator kamzor acid HIn hai jo H+ aur apne anion In- ke saath equilibrium mein hai, aur dono shaklon ke rang mukhtalif hain. Acid H+ deta hai, jo equilibrium ko HIn ki taraf le jata aur acid rang dikhata hai; base H+ ko pani ke taur par hata deta hai, mazeed HIn ionise hota hai, In- ghalib hota hai aur base rang zahir hota hai.

items: Indicators (kamzor organic acids ya bases) acid mein HIn ke taur par ek rang aur base mein In- ke taur par doosra dikhate hain: HIn = H+ + In-; methyl red pH 4.4 par surkh aur 6.2 tak peela.
